description: Build a real visual index for a video using extracted frames, Apple Vision OCR, Apple Vision feature prints, and optional Gemini frame descriptions. Returns frame evidence with local image paths. The index persists across sessions and is queryable via searchVisualContent — call recallWorkspace first to avoid re-indexing. [~30-120s, downloads + OCR + vision]

autoDownload.description: Automatically download a small local video copy if none exists (default true)

downloadFormat.description: Video format used if auto-download is needed (default worst_video)

forceReindex.description: Re-run OCR/description analysis even if frames are already indexed

includeGeminiDescriptions.description: Use Gemini to describe each frame when a Gemini key is configured

includeGeminiEmbeddings.description: Generate Gemini embeddings over OCR/description text for semantic retrieval (default true when Gemini key is available)

videoIdOrUrl.description: Video ID or URL to index visually

name: indexVisualContent
